{{Quote|Samara Mindak is rich, young, and willing to flaunt her advantages. She's popular with the Kaas City elite, but hardly beloved&mdash;no meaningful connections or reputation.|Watcher Two|<ref name="High Society" />}}
'''Samara Mindak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] and social high-flier within the upper class scene on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Mindak harbored a disdain for her father, [[Theovor Mindak]], and was nonchalant when approached by [[Cipher Nine]], an [[Imperial Agent|agent]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] demanding information on his location and state of alliance with the rebel [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]], providing information on his whereabouts and access codes to his lab.

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Although her father thought she was "useless", she possessed a keen social intelligence and was able to detect the sincerity of others, although was cold and often abrasive if people didn't interest her.<ref name="High Society" />

==Behind the scenes==
Samara Mindak appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. She appears in the Imperial Agent mission "High Society" on Dromund Kaas, where the player seeks her out in order to locate her father. Mindak can be threatened into cooperating, bribed with her father's inventions and fortune, or seduced by a male Agent of [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]], and [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Purebloods]] background. She can also be killed by the Agent when she is no longer useful.<ref name="High Society" />
